column_description: TEXT. Unique name of the station. PK.
TIMESTAMP. Timestamp when the location data was recorded. Example: 2024-10-29T17:30:55.
TEXT. Type of location (e.g., field, lab). Possible values: Antarctic, Arctic.
REAL. Latitude of the location in degrees. Example: 80.255202.
REAL. Longitude of the location in degrees. Example: -146.257874.
REAL. Altitude of the location in meters. **NULL means no altitude provided.**. Example: 2054.5.
